root.label: Rubio waives Egypt military aid restriction

events.label: Rubio waives Egypt military aid restriction

slots.name: military aid
slots.sentence: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has waived a restriction on $320 million in military aid to Egypt that had been previously withheld over human rights concerns, citing Egypt’s help in dealing with Iran since the conflict began earlier this year.

slots.name: waiver status
slots.sentence: The State Department said Thursday that Rubio had signed off on the waiver “in the interest of U.S. national security.”
